ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, occurring primarily at the distal tips and in localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation across the visible ventral area; high-contrast white focal spots located on the mid-left lobe and white-to-gray textured mottling at both lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch dividing the fluke into two distinct lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrated profile with irregular peak-and-valley amplitudes along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the lateral edges sweeping upward toward pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-contrast textured pixels at both distal tips corresponding to barnacle colonization; discrete circular white clusters visible on the left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical, high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) detected on the central-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacles) on the fluke tips and scattered white circular scarring on the mid-ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 3D textured masses of barnacle growth concentrated at the trailing edge extremities.
